notes.title: Quick Introduction into BAO
notes.content: This quick livestream is aimed at people who want to know how BAO is played and what the game is all about.

notes.title: Improved tutorial!
notes.content: Among other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: New animals to choose from! New music to listen to!
notes.content: It may be necessary to restart steam in order to receive this new update.

notes.title: New backgrounds and improved invite system
notes.content:
- Three new backgrounds were introduced.
(Click B whilst playing a game to change the background.)
- Slight improvements to the steam friend invite system.

notes.title: Easy invite system introduced!
notes.content:
You can now invite a friend via steam!
1. Open "Online Game" and create a room. (with or without a password)
2. Scroll through your list of friends and click on the invite button next to the friend you want to invite.
3. your friend will have to open the steam chat to accept the invite.
4. back in BAO the game will automatically connect your friend to your room!

notes.title: Introducing BAO
notes.content: A quick overview of BAO, the online version of Bao la Kiswahili.
